title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: Grothendieck is studying the 'structure at infinity' of the moduli stacks M_{g,nu}. The compactification has a normal-crossings boundary, and its stratification by number of double points is being refined into strata D_{d_*} indexed by chains d_* = {d_0 > d_1 > ... > d_r >= 0}. The aim stated on the previous page is to describe the tubular or 'Hermitian' local models V^{d'_0}_{d_*,d''_0}, their variance in d_*, and their fundamental groupoids. The goal is to rebuild all 'modular types' (the stratification together with its Pi_1's).

This page sets up the linear-algebra input. The setting is the local immersion D_{d_*} -> D_0 into the ambient space, with normal bundle Ň_{d_*} = N_{D_{d_*}, D_{d_0}} of rank d_0. The check is used here for the normal bundle; the words 'fibré conormal' are crossed out.

For each i, put Ň_{d_*,d_i} = N_{D_{d_*}, D_{d_i}}, the normal bundle of D_{d_*} in the intermediate stratum D_{d_i} (283), of rank d_i. This gives a canonical decreasing filtration (282):

Ň_{d_*} = Ň_{d_*,d_0} ⊃ Ň_{d_*,d_1} ⊃ ... ⊃ Ň_{d_*,d_r} ⊃ Ň_{d_*,0} = 0.

The inclusions come from the standard exact sequence for a chain of immersions X ⊂ Y ⊂ Z, namely 0 -> N_{X/Y} -> N_{X/Z} -> N_{Y/Z}|_X -> 0. Applied to D_{d_*} -> D_{d_i} -> D_0 this gives (284):

0 -> Ň_{d_*,d_i} -> Ň_{d_*} -> (Ň_{d_i} | D_{d_*}) -> 0.

More generally, for a subchain d'_* ⊂ d_* with d'_0 = d_i, one gets (285):

0 -> N_{D_{d_*}, D_{d'_*}} -> N_{D_{d_*}, D_0} -> (N_{D_{d'_*}} | D_{d_*}) -> 0.

Here N_{D_{d_*}, D_{d'_*}} is identified with Ň_{d_*,d'_0}. So the relative normal bundle depends only on the top index of the subchain, since D_{d'_*} and D_{d'_0} agree near D_{d_*}.

A local model makes the picture concrete. In a transverse slice C^{d_0} at a point with d_0 nodes, the strata are coordinate subspaces, and a chain of strata gives a flag of coordinate subspaces of dimensions d_0 > d_1 > ... > d_r. The next page goes on to define the graded pieces Ň_{d_*;(d'_0,d''_0)} = Ň_{d_*,d''_0} / Ň_{d_*,d'_0} as the most general canonical bundles.

The page thus prepares the linear (normal-bundle) data of the iterated tubular neighbourhoods. These are needed to describe the deleted-neighbourhood homotopy types and their fundamental groupoids, which in turn feed the boundary/'infinity' structure of the Teichmüller tower.
errors: No mathematical error. The exact sequences are the standard normal-bundle sequences for X ⊂ Y ⊂ Z and are correct with Ň read as the normal bundle; Grothendieck himself crossed out 'conormal', which would reverse the arrows.

The notation is slightly overloaded and needs care. D_0 denotes the ambient space, and (282) identifies it with D_{d_0}, whereas Ň_{d_*,0} = {0} means D_{\{0\}} is locally D_{d_*} itself. The index d is therefore effectively the dimension of the stratum in the transverse slice, not its codimension, and 'D_0' as ambient is a separate convention.
The rank labels (rg d_i) are consistent only under this reading: D_{d_*} is a point in a transverse slice of dimension d_0, and D_{d_i} is a d_i-dimensional coordinate stratum.

ideas.what: Canonical filtration of the normal bundle of the deepest stratum of a chain of strata, by the normal bundles into the intermediate strata.
ideas.modern_name: Filtration of the normal bundle along a flag of submanifolds; normal structure of a corner (normal crossings / manifolds with corners, iterated tubular neighbourhoods, Mather control data)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Standard differential topology (Thom-Mather theory of stratified spaces, 1960s-70s)
ideas.where_published: Only allusions to the 'structure à l'infini' / tubular neighbourhoods of the boundary in Esquisse d'un programme (1984); not this explicit construction.

ideas.what: Exact sequence 0 -> N_{X/Y} -> N_{X/Z} -> N_{Y/Z}|_X -> 0 for a chain of (local) immersions, applied to subchains d'_* ⊂ d_*.
ideas.modern_name: Normal bundle sequence for a composite of immersions
ideas.where_published: EGA IV §16 (conormal sheaves and exact sequences for composite immersions)

deep.surprise_reason: The page is routine bookkeeping: a filtration of a normal bundle along a chain of strata, plus standard exact sequences. It is set-up for the later study of tubular-neighbourhood types and their fundamental groupoids at the boundary of M_{g,nu}. That larger program is interesting, but nothing on this page is new or unrecorded mathematics.
transcription_corrections: Line 3 reads 'soit Ň_{d_*}' (not 'sur Ň_{d_*}'): 'pour l'immersion locale D_{d_*} -> D_0 soit Ň_{d_*}, il y a dans Ň_{d_*} une filtration canonique'.
Line 1 is likely 'pour l'immersion locale'; the '82' above it is a page or section number.
The crossed-out passage reads roughly 'intervenant dans la suite exacte de fibrés conormaux associée à la suite d'immersions locales D_{d_*} -> D_{\{d_i\}} -> D_0'.
Below (283), the uncrossed text reads 'dans la suite exacte canonique associée à l'imm. locale D_{d_*} -> D_{d_i}'.
In (284) the middle term is written Ň_{d_*} (with a stray mark), and the quotient is (Ň_{d_i} | D_{d_*}).
